_comment: 30 component specs for the syntax-2.0 acceptance benchmark (docs/syntax-2.0.md §10). Each spec is expressible in all three variants {v1, v2, v2host}; the model receives brief + services verbatim. Scoring is compile-rate against the current checker, so briefs pin interfaces, not implementations.

specs.name: In-memory KV provider
specs.brief: Write a component MemKv that provides kv: Kv backed by a host Map (acquire it with Map.new(), release with drop()). get reads from the map; put inserts with a matching undo that removes the key.

specs.name: Postgres pool provider
specs.brief: Write a component PgDatabase that provides db: Database. It takes config { url: Str, pool_size: Int = 10 }, acquires a connection pool with Pool.open(url, pool_size) (undone by closing it), and passes query and execute through to the pool.

specs.name: Write-through cache with audit log
specs.brief: Write a component UserCache that requires db: Database and provides cache: Cache. It keeps entries in a host Map. put must (a) insert into the map with a matching removal undo, and (b) emit an INSERT into cache_log on the database, interpolating the key into the SQL.

specs.name: Migration runner with advisory lock
specs.brief: Write a component Migrator that requires db: Database. Activation: take a Postgres advisory lock via a query effect (undone by the unlock query), then await Job.run("migrations"), then emit an INSERT into migration_log compensated by the matching DELETE.

specs.name: Rate limiter
specs.brief: Write a component RateLimiter that provides limiter: Limiter, backed by a host Map acquired on activation. allow reads the key's entry; record inserts a marker for the key with a matching removal undo.

specs.name: Audit logger facade
specs.brief: Write a component AuditLogger that requires db: Database and provides audit: Audit. Its log operation emits an INSERT of the event into audit_log on the database (interpolate the event into the SQL).

specs.name: Session store with TTL config
specs.brief: Write a component SessionStore that provides sessions: Sessions with config { ttl: Int = 300 }. Back it with a host Map. put inserts (undo removes); drop_session removes the entry as an effect whose undo re-inserts a tombstone value of your choice.

specs.name: Feature flag service
specs.brief: Write a component FeatureFlags that provides flags: Flags backed by a host Map. enabled reads the flag; set_flag inserts the value with a matching removal undo.

specs.name: Cache with warmup boundary
specs.brief: Write a component WarmCache that requires db: Database and provides cache: Cache. Activation: acquire a host Map, then await Job.run("warmup") so the runtime may divert before the cache goes live, then emit a 'cache online' marker row into the database. Methods as in a write-through cache (map insert with undo; no audit emission needed).

specs.name: Metrics counters
specs.brief: Write a component Metrics that provides metrics: Metrics backed by a host Map. bump inserts the given value under the metric name with a matching removal undo; read returns the current entry.

specs.name: Transactional outbox activation
specs.brief: Write a component Outbox that requires db: Database. Activation is an ordered saga: emit an INSERT of a 'pending' row into outbox compensated by its DELETE, then emit an INSERT of a 'dispatched' marker compensated by its DELETE. No provides.

specs.name: Dual-write replicator
specs.brief: Write a component Replicator that requires primary: Database and replica: Database, and provides sync: Sync. Its write operation emits the SQL on the primary and then emits it on the replica, the second compensated by a DELETE-style counteraction of your choice on the replica.

specs.name: Provider + consumer in one file
specs.brief: Write two components: MemKv provides kv: Kv (Map-backed as usual), and NameBook requires kv: Kv and provides names: Names, where remember stores the name under itself via kv.put and recall reads it back via kv.get.

specs.name: Health check probe
specs.brief: Write a component HealthCheck that requires db: Database. Activation: run a SELECT 1 probe as an effect (undo can re-run a no-op query such as SELECT 0), then await Job.run("healthcheck"), then emit an INSERT of an 'up' marker into health_log.

specs.name: Search index with journal
specs.brief: Write a component SearchIndex that requires db: Database and provides index: Index. Back it with a host Map. add inserts the id into the map (undo removes) and emits an INSERT into index_journal with the id interpolated; lookup reads from the map.

specs.name: Notifier with compensation
specs.brief: Write a component Notifier that requires mail: Mailer and provides notify: Notify. ping emits a send to the user (body of your choice, interpolate the user) compensated by a send to "ops" describing the retraction.

specs.name: Billing ledger with reversal entries
specs.brief: Write a component BillingLedger that requires db: Database and provides billing: Billing. charge emits an INSERT of the charge into ledger, compensated by an INSERT of the matching reversal entry (never a DELETE — ledgers are append-only).

specs.name: Config-driven identity service
specs.brief: Write a component ConfigEcho that provides info: Info with config { name: Str, retries: Int = 3 }. whoami returns the configured name; retries returns the configured retry count. It still needs at least one revertible acquisition: acquire a host Map as scratch state (undo drops it).

specs.name: Lock manager
specs.brief: Write a component LockManager that provides locks: Locks backed by a host Map. acquire_lock inserts a holder marker under the lock name with a matching removal undo; holder reads the entry.

specs.name: Work queue
specs.brief: Write a component WorkQueue that provides queue: Queue backed by a host Map. enqueue inserts the payload under the id with a matching removal undo; peek reads it.

specs.name: Two-stage boot with divert window
specs.brief: Write a component TwoStageBoot that requires kv: Kv. Activation: effect a kv.put of stage=one (undo puts stage=none), then await Job.run("stage-two"), then effect a kv.put of stage=two (undo puts stage=one). A divert during the await must leave only stage one to revert — which your undo ordering already guarantees; just write the two effects around the boundary.

specs.name: Three-layer cascade
specs.brief: Write three components in one file: PgDatabase provides db: Database (Pool-backed, config url with a default pool size); UserCache requires db and provides cache: Cache (Map-backed write-through with an audit emission on put); ApiFront requires cache and provides api: Api, where fetch reads the user's entry from the cache.

specs.name: Dedupe store
specs.brief: Write a component DedupeStore that provides dedupe: Dedupe backed by a host Map. mark inserts a marker under the id with a matching removal undo; seen reads the entry.

specs.name: Normalizing cache
specs.brief: Write a component NormCache that provides cache: Cache backed by a host Map, where keys are normalized before use: a key is trimmed to its first 8 characters. Express the normalization however your syntax variant makes natural (inline method calls on the key, a pure helper function, or a host block); put stores under the normalized key with a matching removal undo, get reads under the normalized key.

specs.name: Checksum service with journal
specs.brief: Write a component ChecksumLog that requires db: Database and provides sum: Sum. digest returns a digest string for the input — compute it however your syntax variant makes natural (delegate to a host object or host block, or derive a simple code from the string's characters). The component's activation emits an INSERT of a 'digest service online' marker into service_log.

specs.name: Log rotator
specs.brief: Write a component LogRotator that requires db: Database with config { keep: Int = 7 }. Activation: emit an INSERT of a rotation marker into rotation_log (interpolating the keep count), compensated by the matching DELETE of that marker.

specs.name: Inventory reservations
specs.brief: Write a component InventoryKeeper that requires db: Database and provides inv: Inventory. Back reservations with a host Map: reserve inserts the quantity under the sku (undo removes) and emits an INSERT into reservation_journal; reserved reads the map.

specs.name: Greeting formatter
specs.brief: Write a component GreeterSvc that provides greeter: Greeter. greet returns a greeting string that includes the caller's name — build it however your syntax variant makes natural (template interpolation, string concat helpers, or a pure function). Acquire a host Map as scratch state so the component has a revertible acquisition.

specs.name: KV + auditor mesh
specs.brief: Write two components: MemKv provides kv: Kv (Map-backed), and Auditor requires kv: Kv and mail: Mailer, provides audited: Audited. put_audited writes through to kv.put and emits a mail.send to "audit" describing the write (interpolate the key).

specs.name: Transfer saga with settlement boundary
specs.brief: Write a component TransferSaga that requires ledger: Database. Activation, in order: take an advisory lock via a query effect (undone by the unlock query); emit the debit INSERT compensated by its reversing credit INSERT; emit the credit INSERT compensated by its reversing debit INSERT; then await Job.run("settle") as the settlement boundary.
